title: Layer-loop starting record
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $n,z,T,t,\ell$ be nonnegative integers, with $z$ a finite Boolean word. Write $S=S(M,n,z,T)$ for the associated stride. Define a record with fields $(n,|z|,T,tS,q,tS,\ell,0,0,0,0,0)$, where $q=0$ if $t=0$ and $q=tS-S$ otherwise.
caveat: The definition does not use x, and the supplied statement does not explain the stride S(M,n,z,T).
